# GoSolarIndex

> GoSolarIndex (gosolarindex.in) is India's verified rooftop solar directory and consumer guide. We connect Indian homeowners, housing societies, and commercial businesses with empanelled solar EPC contractors, DISCOM-registered channel partners, and flagship SolarSquare Experience Centres across 78+ cities.

## Key Facts & Capabilities

- Directory of verified rooftop solar installers, dealers, and maintenance providers across 78+ Indian cities.
- Official PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana subsidy calculator (up to ₹78,000 direct bank transfer for residential 3 kW systems).
- State DISCOM net-metering guidance (MSEDCL, MPPKVVCL, UPPCL, TSSPDCL, BESCOM, TANGEDCO, etc.).
- Complete brand comparisons (Waaree, Tata Power Solar, Vikram Solar, Loom Solar, Adani Solar, SolarSquare).
- Physical SolarSquare Experience Centre hubs in Pune, Nagpur, Nashik, Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, Jabalpur, Lucknow, and Kanpur.
- National Headquarters located in Mumbai (Andheri West) and Regional Corporate Offices in Bengaluru, Gurugram, Jaipur, and Hyderabad.

## Flagship Experience Centres & Headquarters

- [Mumbai HQ](https://gosolarindex.in/mumbai): SolarSquare National Headquarters at Suvidha Square, Andheri West.
- [Pune Experience Centres](https://gosolarindex.in/pune): Dual physical walk-in centres in Kharadi (Nyati Plaza, Thite Nagar) & Wakad (VTP Altitude, Aundh-Ravet BRTS Road).
- [Nagpur Experience Centre](https://gosolarindex.in/nagpur): Full showroom at Glocal Square Mall, Sitabuldi (Open 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM).
- [Nashik Experience Centre](https://gosolarindex.in/nashik): Designated Experience Centre near City Centre Mall, Untwadi & College Road.
- [Bhopal Experience Centre](https://gosolarindex.in/bhopal): Walk-in hub at Ground Floor, Block C, Shrishti C.B.D., South T T Nagar.
- [Indore Experience Centre](https://gosolarindex.in/indore): Walk-in centre at Singapore Business Park, LIG Square, Old AB Road.
- [Gwalior Experience Centre](https://gosolarindex.in/gwalior): Krishna Business Centre, Patel Nagar City Centre.
- [Jabalpur Experience Centre](https://gosolarindex.in/jabalpur): Shashwat Building, Wright Town Commercial Hub.
- [Lucknow Experience Centre](https://gosolarindex.in/lucknow): Local branch & Experience Centre at Vishesh Khand, Gomti Nagar.
- [Kanpur Experience Centre](https://gosolarindex.in/kanpur): Experience Centre at Deep Cinema Complex, Juhi Kalan, Saket Nagar.

## Solar Tools & Subsidy Calculators

- [Solar Subsidy Calculator](https://gosolarindex.in/tools/solar-subsidy-calculator): Calculate PM Surya Ghar central DBT subsidies (₹30,000 to ₹78,000) based on your monthly light bill and sanctioned load.
- [Solar System Size Calculator](https://gosolarindex.in/tools/solar-system-size-calculator): Estimate required kW capacity, rooftop square footage, and units generated per month.
- [Solar Savings Calculator](https://gosolarindex.in/tools/solar-savings-calculator): Compute monthly electricity bill reduction, payback period (3 to 4 years), and 25-year ROI.
- [PM Surya Ghar Scheme Guide](https://gosolarindex.in/subsidy/pm-surya-ghar): Complete step-by-step application walkthrough for the ₹78,000 central subsidy.

## Hardware & Brand Comparisons

- [Solar Panel Brand Comparison India 2026](https://gosolarindex.in/blog/solar-panel-brand-comparison-india-2026): Waaree vs Tata Power vs Vikram Solar vs Loom Solar efficiency, warranty, and DCR compliance.
- [SolarSquare vs Tata Power Solar](https://gosolarindex.in/blog/solarsquare-vs-tata-power-solar-comparison): Comparison of turnkey residential services, elevated mounting structures, and pricing.
- [Waaree vs Vikram Solar](https://gosolarindex.in/compare/waaree-vs-vikram): In-depth comparison of top Indian Tier-1 BloombergNEF module manufacturers.
